definitions.gloss: an introductory chapter or book that lays out the groundwork of a subject — used especially in academic titles and in the openings of scholarly works
definitions.explanation: Found most often in book titles in the humanities, sciences, and philosophy — e.g., 「{哲学|てつがく}{序説|じょせつ}」 ("An Introduction to Philosophy"). More formal and more scholarly than {入門|にゅうもん} or {概論|がいろん}, and typically emphasizes foundational concepts or preliminary arguments that prepare the reader for fuller treatment.

examples.japanese: 「{経済|けいざい}{学|がく}{序説|じょせつ}」を{読|よ}んだ。
この{本|ほん}は{言語学|げんごがく}の{序説|じょせつ}として{定評|ていひょう}がある。
examples.english: This book has an established reputation as an introduction to linguistics.

examples.japanese: {序説|じょせつ}で{著者|ちょしゃ}は{研究|けんきゅう}の{目的|もくてき}と{方法|ほうほう}を{明|あき}らかにしている。
examples.english: In the introduction, the author sets out the aims and methods of the study.

examples.japanese: カントの{書|しょ}いた「{将来|しょうらい}の{形而上学|けいじじょうがく}への{序説|じょせつ}」は、{哲学|てつがく}{史|し}における{重要|じゅうよう}な{著作|ちょさく}である。
examples.english: Kant's "Prolegomena to Any Future Metaphysics" is an important work in the history of philosophy.

notes:
Composed of {序|じょ} ("order, preface, introductory") + {説|せつ} ("theory, discourse"). Literally "introductory discourse," close to the Latin term "prolegomena" in scholarly usage.

USAGE:
- Most commonly appears in book titles and chapter titles of academic works: X{学|がく}{序説|じょせつ} or 「Xへの{序説|じょせつ}」.
- Signals a formal, scholarly register — not suitable for casual writing or everyday introductions.
- Can also refer to the introductory chapter of a book or treatise that lays out its scope, questions, and methods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {哲学|てつがく}{序説|じょせつ}: an introduction to philosophy
- X{学|がく}への{序説|じょせつ}: a prolegomenon to (field) X
- {序説|じょせつ}を{書|か}く: to write an introductory treatise
- {序説|じょせつ}に{当|あ}たる{章|しょう}: the chapter that serves as the introduction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入門|にゅうもん}: introduction, primer — aimed at beginners; much more accessible in tone.
- {概論|がいろん}: general survey — overview of a field, less foundational than {序説|じょせつ}.
- {序論|じょろん}: introductory chapter/argument — often the first chapter of an academic paper or thesis.
- {序文|じょぶん}: preface — the opening remarks of a book, often by the author or editor.
- {前書|まえが}き: foreword — a short prefatory note, usually more personal or practical.
